title: Parameter
description: A named input to an API operation or path item that is carried outside the request body, in the URL path, the query string, a request header or a cookie. It is identified by the pair (name, in) and constrained by either a schema or a single-entry content map. Use RequestBody instead when the input is carried in the HTTP message body, including form fields of application/x-www-form-urlencoded or multipart/form-data payloads. Use Header instead when the header describes a response header, or a multipart part header under an Encoding, where the name comes from a map key and no 'in' location is given. Use ServerVariable instead when the {placeholder} is substituted in a Server URL (host, base path, tenant) rather than in a Paths key template. Use Schema instead when you are modelling the data type or constraints of the value itself rather than the named input slot that carries it.

in.description: Location of the parameter. Path parameters must always have required: true. Default serialization style: 'form' for query/cookie, 'simple' for path/header.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of the parameter's meaning and accepted values, in CommonMark; set it whenever the name alone does not convey semantics or units.

required.description: Whether the client must supply the parameter. It must be true when in is 'path' and defaults to false otherwise; set it to true for mandatory query, header or cookie inputs.

deprecated.description: Marks the parameter as scheduled for removal so that consumers stop sending it. Defaults to false; set it to true when the handler still accepts the parameter but it is slated for removal.

allowEmptyValue.description: Permits a query parameter to be sent with an empty value (e.g. '?flag='). It is valid only when in is 'query', is ignored when style is set, and is discouraged in OpenAPI 3.0.3.

style.description: Serialization style for the parameter value. Defaults: 'form' for query and cookie, 'simple' for path and header.

schema.description: The schema defining the type and constraints for the parameter value

explode.description: When true, array/object values generate separate parameters for each element. Default: true when style is 'form', false otherwise.

allowReserved.description: Allows reserved characters in query parameter values without percent-encoding. Only applies to 'query' parameters.

example.description: An example value for the parameter. Mutually exclusive with 'examples'.

examples.description: Map of named Example objects for the parameter. Mutually exclusive with 'example'.

content.description: Alternative to 'schema' for complex serialization. Mutually exclusive with 'schema'; must contain exactly one map entry keyed by media type string.

x-dr-evidence: Framework parameter bindings on handler arguments, such as Spring @PathVariable/@RequestParam/@RequestHeader/@CookieValue, FastAPI Path()/Query()/Header()/Cookie(), or ASP.NET [FromRoute]/[FromQuery]/[FromHeader].
Handler code reading req.params.<name>, req.query.<name>, req.get('<Header>') or req.cookies.<name> in an Express/Koa-style route registered on a router.
An entry under a 'parameters:' list in an OpenAPI YAML/JSON file, at operation, path-item or components level, containing 'name:' and 'in: path|query|header|cookie'.
